title_cn: 参议员就制裁俄罗斯和伊朗达成两党协议权力平衡：最新版 07/28/2026
summary: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Evelyn Farkas, executive director of the McCain Institute, discusses the role the late Senator Lindsey Graham played in helping persuade President Trump to maintain support for Ukraine and other "front-line democracies." Jared Bernstein, former chair of the Council of Economic Advisers under the Biden administration, discussed the possibility of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates at its upcoming meeting. Former Vice President Mike Pence reflects on the life and foreign-policy legacy of Senator Lindsey Graham, calling him a "tenacious advocate for American freedom at home and abroad." (Source: Bloomberg)
